name: images-edits-200
notes: M8.5 contract fixture: POST /v1/images/edits returns the mock upstream's edited-image payload verbatim. The apitest harness can only send JSON bodies, so this fixture carries no request.body: the test builds a real multipart/form-data request itself (model + prompt fields + one PNG part), loads this fixture for the recorded response and assertions, and checks the response with apitest.CheckResponse directly instead of apitest.Run. The recorded b64_json is a canned 1x1 PNG, not a real image; no usage block is recorded (unknown stays unknown, never estimated).
recorded_from: mock-upstream: canned OpenAI-shaped images response replayed by the test's fake engine, 2026-11-19. Recorded mock data, NOT a live provider call.
